blocks.text: United States President Donald J. Trump boasted last week following a meeting with President Marcos that he struck the “biggest trade deal” ever with the Philippines, which he claimed had agreed to source “100 percent” of its agricultural imports as well as energy needs from the US. “We’ve just consummated a very big trade deal, the biggest trade deal we’ve ever made by far, and it’s a fair deal for both countries, and we’re very happy with it,” said Trump, who was honored with a presidential luncheon during his whirlwind visit to the Philippines.
